ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: When animals first receive stimulation from a certain antigen, it can trigger a primary immune response; when they receive stimulation from the same antigen again, it can trigger a secondary immune response. A research group took several experimental mice and divided them into four groups for an experiment. The experimental grouping and treatments are shown in the table below. After antigen is injected again, which of the above four groups of mice can show a secondary immune response?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: When animals first receive stimulation from a certain antigen, it can trigger a primary immune response; when they receive stimulation from the same antigen again, it can trigger a secondary immune response. A research group took several experimental mice and divided them into four groups for an experiment. The experimental grouping and treatments are shown in the table below. After antigen is injected again, which of the above four groups of mice can show a secondary immune response?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The table lists the mouse groups as Group A, Group B, Group C, and Group D. In the row for first antigen injection, Groups A and B correspond to antigen A, and Groups C and D correspond to antigen B; the middle indicates an interval of a suitable period of time; in the row for second antigen injection, Group A is antigen A, Group B is antigen B, Group C is antigen A, and Group D is antigen B. Reasoning: The stem states that only receiving stimulation from the same antigen again can trigger a secondary immune response. Comparing the first and second antigens group by group: Group A is A→A, the antigens are the same, so it can show a secondary immune response; Group B is A→B, the antigens are different, so it cannot show a secondary immune response against the same antigen; Group C is B→A, the antigens are different, so it cannot show one; Group D is B→B, the antigens are the same, so it can show a secondary immune response. Therefore, the groups that can show a secondary immune response are Group A and Group D.
